title: Xorshift32
hints: Do the three steps in order, each one updating x: x ^= x << 13, then x ^= x >> 17, then x ^= x << 5.
Everything must stay within 32 bits. A left shift can push bits past bit 31, and those must be thrown away (the result is taken mod 2³²).
Python: mask with & 0xFFFFFFFF after each left shift. Rust: work in u32 (`state as u32`). C++: work in std::uint32_t.

tests.description: all 32 bits set: the shifted-out bits must be dropped
